🎥🎬: Prometheus (2012)

In the late 21st century, scientists Elizabeth Shaw and Charlie Holloway discover ancient symbols across different civilizations that appear to point toward humanity’s creators. Funded by the powerful Weyland Corporation, they lead an expedition aboard the spaceship Prometheus to a distant moon in search of answers about the origins of human life.

Upon arrival, the crew discovers an abandoned alien structure containing mysterious artifacts, strange organisms, and evidence of a civilization far more dangerous than they imagined. As the investigation progresses, their discoveries unleash a terrifying biological threat that begins turning the mission into a fight for survival.

With trust collapsing and the crew facing unimaginable horrors, Shaw struggles to uncover the truth behind humanity’s creators. But the answers she finds raise even more disturbing questions about the beings who may have engineered life on Earth—and their intentions for mankind.

source_details.synopsis: Prometheus is a 2012 science fiction horror film directed by Ridley Scott and written by Jon Spaihts and Damon Lindelof. It is the fifth installment of the Alien film series and features an ensemble cast including Noomi Rapace, Michael Fassbender, Guy Pearce, Idris Elba, Logan Marshall-Green, and Charlize Theron. Set in the late 21st century, the film centers on the crew of the spaceship Prometheus as it follows a star map discovered among the artifacts of several ancient Earth cultures. Seeking the origins of humanity, the crew arrives on a distant world and discovers a threat that could cause human extinction.
